issues.title: Handler logic mixed in schema file
issues.description: The rule requires that schema and handler logic are separated into different files. However, the schema file `booking.output.ts` now contains a handler method `cleanEmailForDisplay()` that performs email validation and transformation logic, mixing schema definition with handler logic in the same file.
issues.rule_name: Schema and Handler Files Must Be Separated with Type-Safe Patterns

issues.title: Lost `this` context in displayGuests mapping causes runtime error
issues.description: In the `getOutputBooking` method at line 171, the code passes `this.getDisplayEmail` directly to the `map` function without binding the `this` context. This causes a runtime error because when `getDisplayEmail` is invoked inside the `map` callback, `this` will be `undefined`, resulting in "Cannot read property 'replace' of undefined" or similar errors. The arrow function `(guest: string) => this.getDisplayEmail(guest)` was removed, which was necessary to preserve the `this` binding. This will break all bookings that have guests.

issues.title: Recurring seated bookings returned in wrong order
issues.description: In the `getOutputRecurringSeatedBookings` method at line 424, the sort operation that orders bookings chronologically by start time has been removed. The original code sorted bookings with `.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.start).getTime() - new Date(b.start).getTime())` to ensure they are returned in chronological order. Without this sorting, recurring bookings will be returned in an arbitrary order (based on how they were stored in the database or map), which breaks the expected API contract and will confuse clients expecting chronological ordering of recurring events.

issues.title: Unnecessary regex processing on literal "unknown" string
issues.description: In the `getHost` method at line 219, when the user is null/unknown, the code now calls `this.getDisplayEmail("unknown")` instead of directly setting `displayEmail: "unknown"`. This causes unnecessary regex processing on the literal string "unknown" which has no CUID suffix to remove. While this doesn't break functionality, it adds unnecessary computational overhead and is semantically incorrect - the getDisplayEmail method is designed to strip CUID suffixes from actual email addresses, not process placeholder strings. This represents a performance issue and code smell that violates the principle of only processing data when necessary.

issues.title: Service file uses disallowed '.service.ts' suffix / naming convention violation
issues.description: Rule 1 disallows dot-suffix service filenames like '.service.ts' and requires service files to be named '<Entity>Service.ts' with matching PascalCase. This PR modifies a service located at 'services/output.service.ts', which violates the naming convention.
issues.rule_name: Rule 1: Repository and Service Classes Must Follow Naming Conventions

issues.title: Line(s) exceed the 110 character line width requirement
issues.description: The added assignment line is longer than the 110 character limit required by the Biome formatting rules for TS/JS files.
issues.rule_name: Rule 3: Use Biome for Code Formatting with Standardized Configuration

issues.title: JSON formatting deviates from expected formatter output (indentation removed)
issues.description: The PR introduces improperly indented JSON (the 'required' key is moved to column 1). This indicates the JSON was not kept formatted per the repository’s formatting/lint-staged expectations (Biome format for JSON).

pr.title: Code Review Bench PR #25593 - fix(api): return original email without OAuth suffix in bookings

structured_output.summary:
The PR adds a `displayEmail` field next to the existing `email` on booking outputs in API v2 (2024-08-13). It strips the `+{cuid}` OAuth suffix with a regex in `OutputBookingsService_2024_08_13`, and adds `displayGuests` for guest lists. The change is additive, so existing `email` values stay as they are. The main changes are in `output.service.ts`, the output DTOs in `booking.output.ts`, the OpenAPI doc, and e2e tests.

The direction is sound, and keeping `email` unchanged avoids a breaking change for platform customers. Three things block a clean merge. The regex is unanchored and corrupts some legitimate emails. An unrelated sort removal in `getOutputRecurringSeatedBookings` changes response ordering without explanation. The OpenAPI edits are malformed and the oasdiff suppressions hide the schema change. The tests also have some tautological assertions.
structured_output.verdictRationale: The unanchored regex can silently rewrite valid addresses with long plus tags, and the recurring-seated sort removal is an unrelated behavior change with no test. Both should be fixed before merge. The OpenAPI JSON is also malformed (mis-indented `required` arrays), and the oasdiff suppressions hide the schema change. The rest is cleanup.

architecture.overview:
Booking responses in API v2 (2024-08-13) are built in `OutputBookingsService_2024_08_13`. `BookingsService` picks the single, recurring, or seated path, and the output service maps database rows into DTO-shaped objects. Output DTOs in `packages/platform/types/bookings/2024-08-13/outputs/booking.output.ts` describe the wire shape, and the OpenAPI JSON is generated from them.

This PR adds a `displayEmail` field beside each raw `email` in attendees, hosts, `reassignedTo`, and `bookingFieldsResponses`. It also adds `displayGuests`. Values come from a single regex helper that strips a `+` followed by 25 alphanumeric characters. The raw `email` is left alone, so existing clients keep working. The same helper is duplicated in the output DTO class.
steps: Entry point: `BookingsService` routes `GET /v2/bookings/{uid}` and related calls to the single, seated, or recurring output method in `OutputBookingsService_2024_08_13`.
The output service maps attendees, users, and `bookingFieldsResponses`. The PR adds a private `getDisplayEmail` helper and calls it at each site that emits an email.
`getOutputRecurringSeatedBookings` now returns results in `bookingsIds` order. The previous start-time sort was removed as part of this change, which is unrelated to the feature.
The DTO classes in `booking.output.ts` gain `displayEmail` fields with `@ApiProperty` and `@IsString`, plus a duplicated static helper that is never called.
The OpenAPI JSON gains `displayEmail` in several schemas and the oasdiff suppression list is extended. The `required` arrays were re-indented incorrectly.

findings.title: Unanchored regex corrupts valid emails with long plus tags
findings.fixPrompt: In `apps/api/v2/src/ee/bookings/2024-08-13/services/output.service.ts`, the private `getDisplayEmail` helper (around lines 96-98) uses `/\+[a-zA-Z0-9]{25}/`, which strips any `+` tag of 25+ alphanumerics, including legitimate ones, and can leave stray characters behind. Anchor the pattern to the CUID immediately before the `@` (for example with a `(?=@)` lookahead and a lowercase CUID character class), and make sure the same regex is not duplicated in `packages/platform/types/bookings/2024-08-13/outputs/booking.output.ts`. Add a unit test that covers a normal `+tag` email and a long non-CUID tag. Keep the output behaviour the same for real CUID suffixes.

findings.title: Unrelated sort removal changes recurring seated booking order
findings.fixPrompt: In `apps/api/v2/src/ee/bookings/2024-08-13/services/output.service.ts`, `getOutputRecurringSeatedBookings` (around lines 411-425) used to end with `return transformed.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.start).getTime() - new Date(b.start).getTime());` and this PR replaced it with `return transformed;`. This is unrelated to the displayEmail change and is not covered by any test. Restore the original sort. If the sort is genuinely no longer wanted, move that change to a separate PR with a test that asserts the intended order.

findings.title: Malformed OpenAPI JSON and suppressed oasdiff errors
findings.body:
The `required` arrays that the PR edits in `docs/api-reference/v2/openapi.json` are indented at column 0. For example, the `required` at line 31729 has no leading indentation, and the same happens at lines 31833, 32267, and 33370. The file still parses as JSON, but the diff is noisy and breaks the formatting convention.

The PR also adds several entries to `.github/oasdiff-err-ignore.txt`. These suppress breaking-change checks for the response `oneOf` lists. The additions mean the schema change will not be flagged in future diffs, so reviewers will not see if the schema drifts further.

::diff{file="docs/api-reference/v2/openapi.json" lines="31729-31735"}

Re-indent the `required` arrays to match the surrounding JSON, and confirm the regenerated spec is what the generator emits. Then reduce the ignore-list additions to only what oasdiff really cannot evaluate.
findings.fixPrompt: In `docs/api-reference/v2/openapi.json`, the `"required": [` lines added by this PR (around 31729, 31833, 32267, 33370) are indented at column 0 instead of matching the surrounding JSON. Re-indent them to match the file's style, ideally by regenerating the spec with the project's generator rather than hand-editing. Also review the new entries in `.github/oasdiff-err-ignore.txt`: they suppress breaking-change checks for the booking response `oneOf` lists, so keep only the entries that oasdiff truly cannot evaluate.

findings.title: Unused static helper duplicates getDisplayEmail
findings.body:
`BookingAttendee.cleanEmailForDisplay` in the output DTO file is never called. It repeats the same regex as the service-level `getDisplayEmail`, so the two copies can drift apart. Delete it, or have the service call one shared helper.

::diff{file="packages/platform/types/bookings/2024-08-13/outputs/booking.output.ts" lines="58-62"}
findings.fixPrompt: In `packages/platform/types/bookings/2024-08-13/outputs/booking.output.ts`, the static method `BookingAttendee.cleanEmailForDisplay` (around lines 58-62) is unused and duplicates the regex in `getDisplayEmail` in `apps/api/v2/src/ee/bookings/2024-08-13/services/output.service.ts`. Remove it, or move the regex into one shared helper that both files import.

findings.title: Weak tautological assertions in seated e2e tests
findings.fixPrompt: In `apps/api/v2/src/ee/bookings/2024-08-13/controllers/e2e/seated-bookings.e2e-spec.ts`, the `displayEmail` expectations around lines 280 and 424 compare the response to itself (for example `createdSeatedBooking.attendees[0].displayEmail`). Replace them with the expected literal email, derived from the input email with the CUID suffix stripped, so the test fails if the field is missing or wrong.

findings.title: Duplicated displayEmail blocks in getOutputBooking and getOutputSeatedBooking
findings.body:
The `bookingFieldsResponses.displayEmail` and `displayGuests` logic is copied almost verbatim into `getOutputBooking` and the seated variant. The only difference is one callback written as `this.getDisplayEmail` and the other as an arrow wrapper. The unbound method reference works because the helper never reads `this`, but that is fragile. Extract a single private method that takes a booking response object and adds both fields.

::diff{file="apps/api/v2/src/ee/bookings/2024-08-13/services/output.service.ts" lines="155-172"}
findings.fixPrompt: In `apps/api/v2/src/ee/bookings/2024-08-13/services/output.service.ts`, the `bookingFieldsResponses.displayEmail` and `displayGuests` blocks (around lines 155-172 and 300-318) are duplicated. Extract them into one private helper that takes the transformed booking and adds both fields, and call it from both methods. Use an arrow or `.bind` for the guest mapping so the helper is not passed as an unbound method reference.

findings.title: Additive displayEmail keeps the original email for compatibility
findings.body: Keeping `email` unchanged and adding `displayEmail` next to it is the right call for platform customers who depend on the current format. The change is additive, so existing clients keep working. Each affected output (attendees, hosts, reassignedTo, `bookingFieldsResponses`) gets the same field, which makes the new contract easy to explain.

findings.title: New e2e tests cover host, attendee, and guest display emails
findings.body: The new `displayEmail fields` block in `managed-user-bookings.e2e-spec.ts` covers the host path, the attendee path, and `displayGuests`. Many existing `toEqual` assertions were also updated to include `displayEmail`, so the response shape is checked in many places. The main gap is the regex edge cases, which are not tested.
